properties.label: Fire
properties.description: Preset fires one of the unit's built-in sequences. Shot fires a static flame at one angle for a set length. Sweep moves from a start angle to an end angle while firing.

properties.label: Preset
properties.description: The flame unit's presets by name, with each one's real length. Picking one sets Preset #.

properties.label: Preset #
properties.description: Number of the built-in preset to fire, as listed in the unit's manual.

properties.label: Angle
properties.description: One button per named angle position, laid out as the fan. Click to set the angle (switches a Preset effect to Shot). Shift-click adds the position to the angle pattern.

properties.label: Angle °
properties.description: Nozzle angle in degrees, 0 = straight up. For Sweep this is the start angle.

properties.label: End Angle °
properties.description: Where a Sweep ends. Back-to-back sweeps go back and forth between the two angles.

properties.label: Shot Length ms
properties.description: How long the flame runs. For a single shot this also sets the effect's length (and dragging the effect updates it); for repeated shots it is each shot's length.

properties.label: Repeat
properties.description: Once fires a single shot. Back-to-back fires again as soon as each shot ends, for as long as the effect lasts. On timing marks fires at every mark of a timing track inside the effect; a shot still burning when the next mark comes is cut short. Random fires scattered shots on each unit (on a group, every unit gets its own pattern), the same every render.

properties.label: Timing Track
properties.description: The timing track whose marks trigger each shot.

properties.label: Angle Pattern
properties.description: Angle positions to use, e.g. 1,8,15,8. Repeats step through them in order; Random picks one at random for each shot. Empty uses the single angle.

properties.label: Gap ms
properties.description: Back-to-back: extra wait between shots. Random: the shortest gap between one unit's shots. Fire always drops for at least one frame so the unit can fire again.

properties.label: Shots/sec
properties.description: Random: average number of shots per second on each unit.

properties.label: Shot Max ms
properties.description: Random: shots vary in length between Shot Length and this. 0 keeps every shot at Shot Length.

properties.label: Move early
properties.description: Send the angle ahead of the fire command by the nozzle's travel time (from the manual), so the flame lands on time. The effect starts earlier to make room; the move shows as a hatched band on the timeline.

properties.label: Fit length to preset
properties.description: Size the effect on the timeline to the preset's real length. Resizing the effect by hand turns this off.
